author: mwgcotah
quote: Game is boring, sandbox elements are extremely boring, "make my own fun"? not here. Driving is horrible, i was really excited to drive in a nice city, nope. cant bump anything way to slippery, barely even trading paint and weird wasted 1hp cutscene. character personallities give me a headache from cringe. all of them. the cutscenes are unenjoyable, i end up doom scrolling during them, thats how uninteresting they are. gunplay is somehow worse than 4. not sure how. gta 5 it was fun. Driving is worse than 4. but atleast 4's era, they didn't have sway bars or TCS/ABS, i honestly couldn't find my self to continue playing. launched gta 4, then 5, and realized the game 100% is boring and ****, thought maybe it was me "ive grown past gaming, im desynentized because of so many good games." nope. removed the blinder. so sony denied my refund. charged it back under consumers laws since i had access to the product for less than 48 hours. and its a license not a physical product they just hope you dont know that and fall for their 'store front policies' consumer laws override that.
